def-hyp(list-partial(
  Algebra.Field(K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $+_K$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $\cdot_K$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace),
  Type.annotation(@V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Type),
  Type.annotation(@$+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Type.to(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Type.to(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace))),
  Type.annotation(@$\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Type.to(K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Type.to(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)))
), LA.VectorSpace(K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace), struct[enumerate](
  member[colon](LA.Law.addCommutative, Logic.forall-typed(list-partial(@a, @b), V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Add($+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, a, b), LA.Add($+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, b, a)))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.addAssociative, Logic.forall-typed(list-partial(@a, @b, @c), V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Add($+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, a, LA.Add[paren]($+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, b, c)), LA.Add($+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, LA.Add[paren]($+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, a, b), c)))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.addIdentity, Logic.forall-typed(@a, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Add($+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, a, LA.Zero(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace)), a))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.addInverse, Logic.forall-typed(@a, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Logic.exists-typed(@b, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Add($+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, a, b), LA.Zero(V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace))))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.smulAssociative, Logic.forall-typed(list-partial(@k, @l), K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Logic.forall-typed(@a, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Smul($\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, k, LA.Smul[paren]($\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, l, a)), LA.Smul($\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, parentheses(Algebra.mul[juxt](k,l)), a))))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.smulDistribVector, Logic.forall-typed(@k, K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Logic.forall-typed(list-partial(@a, @b), V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Smul($\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, k, LA.Add[paren]($+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, a, b)), LA.Add($+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, LA.Smul($\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, k, a), LA.Smul($\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, k, b)))))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.smulDistribScalar, Logic.forall-typed(list-partial(@k, @l), K@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Logic.forall-typed(@a, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Smul($\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, parentheses(Add.add(k,l)), a), LA.Add($+$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, LA.Smul($\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, k, a), LA.Smul($\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, l, a)))))),
  member[colon](LA.Law.smulIdentity, Logic.forall-typed(@a, V@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, Eq(LA.Smul($\cdot$@LinearAlgebra.ctxt.vectorSpace, $1$, a), a)))
))

values.zh-CN: K 上的线性空间是带加法与数乘的类型 V，满足加法交换群公理、数乘结合律、两条分配律及 1·v = v。
values.en: A vector space over K is a type V with addition and scalar multiplication satisfying the additive-commutative-group axioms, scalar associativity, both distributive laws, and 1·v = v.
